title: CGES — Raw payload reference (MinIO offload)
description: When the raw payload exceeds 64 KB, it is offloaded to MinIO and referenced via this object instead of inline raw_data. See ADR-0006 §Deliberate divergence from OCSF and ADR-0003 §Rule 3.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the offloaded payload (lowercase, 64 chars).

size_bytes.description: Payload size in bytes. Strictly greater than 64 KB; smaller payloads must use the inline raw_data field instead.

content_type.description: MIME type of the offloaded payload.
